summary: Iteration 11 (cover photos, service reminders, appliance history, job costs). Backend: main agent's suite and regression suites all pass (80/80 with -n 0: iter11 + iter7 + iter8 + onboarding*). My new edge suite test_iter11_edge.py passes 4 of 5. Passing: email claim (emailed_for), undo only the newest log, date/cost validation, book reuse + HVAC trade guess, Fix-it card hidden while a job is open, outcome cost -> service log, editing to a no-show reverts, cover ownership. 1 real bug: a finished service job vanishes from history if reminders were stopped while the job was open. Frontend (375x667, test_ui11) tested end to end and all working: Fix-it Service tile and card with Mark done / Book a pro / History; DoneSheet (day, pro, cost, note) -> toast + Undo -> card comes back; appliance screen stats, service card, ScheduleSheet (interval, month chips, email switch, save, stop, set again); Book a pro -> issue with Routine service badge -> issue-appliance row opens the appliance, 'Open job' state; outcome form shows the cost field only when Showed up = Yes -> outcome cost badge $185.25 -> appliance history 'Service done $185.25 · Alpine Plumbing', next due +1 year; Rentals cover art in a different colour per rental, real file-chooser upload swaps banner to photo, 'Change', remove back to the drawing; Appliances list -> appliance; Bench and Snap rental chip avatars (svg or photo); ItemSheet item-history-button -> appliance (hidden in the appliance-screen edit sheet); Pin on map on its own row for an unverified rental. No console errors. test_ui11 state restored afterwards (water heater yearly service due Oct 30, no logs or jobs, no covers).

minor.issue: A finished service job disappears from history if the item had no service schedule when the showed-up outcome was saved (host stopped reminders while the job was open). sync_service_job only records a log when item.service exists, and item_history skips kind='service' resolved issues. Result: repairs=[] and services=[], so the cost and contractor are lost from history and total_cost. Reproduced by tests/test_iter11_edge.py::test_service_job_after_stop_keeps_history.
emailed_for is claimed before send_email. If the send fails (EmailError), that due date is never retried. Consider un-claiming on failure.
Undo restores prev_service as a whole, so any interval or email change made after logging is reverted too (edge case).

ui_bugs.issue: Secondary button label is cut off as 'Edit remin...' at 375px width
Changing the interval (e.g. yearly -> every 6 months) does not recompute next_due from last_done. The due date stays a year out unless the host also picks a month.

issues: property-card-<id>-cover-button ('Add photo'/'Change') is about 34-35px tall, under the 44px minimum touch target

House-drawing palette is hash(id) % 6 palettes, so two rentals can easily get the same colour (about 44% chance with 3 rentals). This conflicts with the user's 'different colour per rental' choice. Assign palettes by the rental's index in the host's list instead.
'Load demo' / 'Reset demo' buttons are cut off ('Load de...', 'Reset de...') when shown side by side
'Rheem · XE50' is repeated in both the screen sub-title and the header card
Interval labels don't match: backend/Fix-it say 'Yearly', the app says 'Every year'
A service job is titled 'Plumbing at Tahoe Cabin'. A title like 'Water heater service at Tahoe Cabin' would be clearer.

action_items: Fix the service-job history hole: in sync_service_job, when done and item has no service, still insert a service_log (without moving next_due), or have item_history keep resolved service issues that have no service_log. Re-run tests/test_iter11_edge.py.
Give rentals distinct house colours (palette by index in the host's sorted property list) so ≤6 rentals never share a colour
Make property cover button at least 44px tall; fix the truncated 'Edit reminder' label (shorter label or stack the buttons)
Optional: when the interval changes in the ScheduleSheet and last_done exists, suggest last_done + interval as the due date
Optional: un-claim emailed_for when send_email fails so the reminder is retried
critical_code_review_comments: maintenance_routes.py is a clean module: Pydantic validation, ownership checks via get_owned, _id excluded, atomic email claim
record_service in sync uses outcome datetime .date() (UTC), so a late-evening outcome in US time zones logs the next day
Manual 'Mark done' while a service job is open, followed by the job's showed-up outcome, creates two service logs for one service

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested flows working; minor design issues only

rca_of_issue: History hole: sync_service_job's branch `elif done and item.get('service')` skips logging when the schedule was removed, and item_history `continue`s past resolved kind='service' issues, assuming a service_log exists. Repro: PUT service -> POST book -> DELETE service -> POST outcome showed_up with cost -> GET history shows no record.
